2 large eggs
1 cup warm water
1/2 cup vegetable oil
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
Instructions:

messages.content: Tell me a bedtime story about a dragon for a five-year-old.

response:
Once upon a time, in a magical land far away, there was a friendly dragon named Sparkles. Sparkles loved to play and have fun, but sometimes he would get a little mischievous.
One day, Sparkles decided to go on an adventure. He flew high up into the sky and saw a beautiful castle below. He flew down to the castle and discovered that it was home to a kind king and queen. They welcomed Sparkles with open arms and invited him to stay in the castle.
But not everyone in the castle was happy to see Sparkles. One of the castle's guards, named Sir Reginald, was very grumpy and didn't want the dragon around. He thought that dragons were dangerous and scary.
The next day, Sir Reginald decided to play a trick on Sparkles. He painted the castle walls with pictures of scary monsters and made loud noises to scare Sparkles away. But Sparkles was not afraid. He saw through Sir Reginald's trick and decided to have a little fun of his own.
Sparkles flew up into the sky and let out a big roar. The sound was so loud that it shook the castle walls and scared Sir Reginald right out of his boots.
The king and queen were impressed with Sparkles' bravery and asked him to stay in the castle forever. They even gave him his own room in the castle where he could sleep every night.
From that day on, Sparkles and Sir Reginald became the best of friends. They played together and had lots of fun, and the castle was a happier place because of it.
And so, my little one, the moral of this story is that sometimes things aren't as scary as they seem,
